name: Numena: Brand
description: The brand identity, voice, and visual system for Numena — written as a small set of Markdown documents with an explicit dependency graph.

conventions.layout: Flat brand/ directory; each document is one file.
conventions.readingOrder: Documents sorted so every dependency is read before the document that needs it.
conventions.authority: Each decision has one authoritative document; summaries never override their sources.

documents.title: Foundation
documents.summary: Why Numena exists, what it believes, who it is for, how it is positioned, the boundary it keeps, and how it talks about itself.

documents.title: Visual language
documents.summary: How the visual system is applied — restraint, surfaces, accent roles, spacing, and composition.

documents.title: Color
documents.summary: The palette, its intended meaning, proportion, and accessibility rules.

documents.title: Iconography
documents.summary: Role, specs, sizes, states, and the core icon set.

documents.title: Typography
documents.summary: Typefaces, scale, hierarchy, spacing, and accessibility.

documents.title: Logo
documents.summary: The marks, lockups, color specifications, clear space, and usage rules.

documents.title: Voice
documents.summary: How Numena writes and speaks — principles, examples, and words to avoid.
